game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Echo Chamber Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Echo Chamber.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: In Echo Chamber, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Echo Chamber. Each round, skeleton miners strike the crystal door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from skeleton miners in Echo Chamber: keep the loop_safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Echo Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while loop_safety > 0.
